description: Save slots around the village-state save (Features WV1, P1.core-slots; catalog saves-slots-autosave; ruling U83(1)): deleting a slot and what the slot list and the Continue target become; autosave at an interval with its indicator ("Saving…", "Saved!", "Save failed"); quick save on F5 and quick load on F9 (core's KeyboardMap), including F9 with an empty or corrupted quick slot and a game with no quick slot. The quick slot is dedicated by default, after the manual slots and titled "Quick save", so F5 never writes over a manual save; a game may name a manual slot instead, and a quickSlot that is not one is refused with a code (PL.quick-slot, ruling U88(5)). Delete asks first and says what happened in core's words (PL.slots-delete-states, ruling U88(2)): the prompt, the five delete states of the indicator and the history line, all from one table (contract deleteWords, {n} the slot's index + 1). The session does no I/O: each step returns the effect the host performs (write, read, remove) and the host reports it with a finished step. Runner: src/save-slots-corpus.ts (ops config, continue, rows, indicator, run). Numbers compare within tolerance; everything else exactly, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent). A non-finite number is written as null in an input. Regenerate with npm run save-slots-corpus; npm run save-slots-corpus:check fails on any difference.
sources: Rules new in core (src/save-slots.ts, src/ui/save-indicator-model.ts), from the original game: babylon origin/main WorldStateManager (MAX_SAVE_SLOTS 3, AUTO_SAVE_INTERVAL_MS 5 min, deleteSlot), SaveIndicator (hold 1000 ms, fade 2000 ms, "Saved!" / "Save failed"), GameMenuSystem (one save, load or delete at a time; "No save data"), MainMenuScreen (Continue is the most recent); core KeyboardMap KEY_QUICK_SAVE F5 / KEY_QUICK_LOAD F9 (its old "slot 0" is now the explicit quickSlot 0; the default is the dedicated quick slot, PL.quick-slot, U88(5)).
Inputs are synthetic; every expected is core's answer, and src/conformance/__tests__/save-slots.test.ts pins the same rules independently.

contract.packParametersRule: packs/saves/pack.json names its parameters as the keys of packParameters; each sets the session config key it maps to. Only the slot count differs (pack maxSlots, session slotCount); config reads maxSlots when slotCount is absent, so a binding may pass the pack's parameters as they are
contract.configRule: slotCount (else maxSlots): a finite number of at least 1, rounded down, else 3 (the manual slots); quickSlot: unset or "dedicated" is the dedicated quick slot, index slotCount, one more row after the manual ones; null is none; an integer index of a manual slot is that slot; an integer that is not one (negative, or slotCount or more) is refused quick_slot_out_of_range and any other value quick_slot_not_an_index: quickSlot is then null and the resolved config carries refusal (absent otherwise), never clamped, never the dedicated slot; autosaveIntervalSec: finite and at least 0, else 300; autosaveIndicator: a boolean, else true
contract.rowsRule: one row per slot in index order: the manual slots (isManual true), then the dedicated quick slot when there is one (isManual false, isQuick true; title "Quick save", or "Quick save · " and the save's preview line or "Corrupted Save"; canSave and canDelete false, canLoad as any slot); every action off while an operation runs or the prompt is open

indicatorLabels.deleted_autosave_off: Slot {n} deleted. Autosave is off until you save or load again.
indicatorLabels.delete_failed: Slot {n} could not be deleted. Nothing was changed.
indicatorLabels.nothing_to_delete: Slot {n} is empty: there is nothing to delete.

deleteWords.confirmPrompt: Delete the save in Slot {n}? This cannot be undone.
deleteWords.deletedAutosaveOff: Slot {n} deleted. Autosave is off until you save or load again.
deleteWords.failed: Slot {n} could not be deleted. Nothing was changed.
deleteWords.empty: Slot {n} is empty: there is nothing to delete.

contract.slotNumberRule: every {n} in deleteWords (and so in a delete state's label) is the slot's index + 1 in decimal, as the slot list's titles number it ("Slot 1" is index 0); a delete state shown with no slot, or a slot that is not an integer of at least 0, is hidden; any other state ignores a slot
contract.confirmRule: ask_delete opens the prompt (view.confirm: {slot, prompt, actions [{step confirm_delete, label Delete}, {step cancel_delete, label Cancel}]}) for a slot that is not empty; while it is open every other request and both keys are refused confirm_open (an unbound key stays unbound_key), every row action is off and the autosave count holds; confirm_delete closes it and starts the remove; cancel_delete closes it and shows delete_cancelled; either with no prompt open: refused nothing_to_confirm
contract.deleteStatesRule: a finished delete shows deleted, or deleted_autosave_off when the slot was the autosave target with autosave on (interval above 0), and its result carries history ("Deleted Slot N"); a failed one shows delete_failed and no history; delete or ask_delete on an empty slot is refused slot_empty and shows nothing_to_delete; on a slot that does not exist, refused no_such_slot and the indicator is unchanged; while the remove runs the indicator is unchanged (there is no in-progress delete state)

slotMessages.invalid_format: Unrecognized save format — this slot cannot be loaded.
slotMessages.missing_save_file: Save data is missing or unreadable.
slotMessages.integrity_mismatch: Save file integrity check failed — file may be corrupted or tampered.

contract.continueRule: the loadable (ok) slot with the latest summary.savedAt (Date.parse of an ISO time: an instant, its zone offset applied with its sign, so the same instant written two ways is a tie); a tie goes to the lowest index; an unreadable or missing time is older than any readable one; no loadable slot: null
contract.deleteRule: a slot that is not empty becomes empty; the active slot, if deleted, becomes none (autosave stops until the next save or load); delete removes at once, ask_delete asks first (confirmRule)
contract.autosaveRule: writes the active slot (last saved to or loaded) once the seconds since the last finished save (success or failure) or successful load reach autosaveIntervalSec; the count holds while any operation runs; one autosave per crossing; interval 0 or no active slot: never
contract.quickRule: F5 writes the quick slot, creating it when empty; F9 reads it; by default that is the dedicated quick slot (index slotCount), so F5 never writes a manual slot; F9 on an empty quick slot: refused slot_empty, indicator nothing_to_load (never a fallback to another slot); on a corrupted one: refused slot_corrupted, indicator load_failed with the slot message; quickSlot null: both refused no_quick_slot, nothing shown; a refused quickSlot: both refused with the config's refusal code, nothing shown; save, delete and ask_delete on the dedicated quick slot: refused quick_slot_reserved, nothing shown; a load of it from the list and Continue treat it as any slot
contract.busyRule: while an operation runs every request and both keys are refused busy (an unbound key stays unbound_key) and every row action is off; a due autosave waits
